title: Nonadaptive One-Sided Testing of Binary Rank
abstract: arXiv:2611.14163v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The binary rank of a binary matrix is the minimum number of disjoint all-one rectangles that partition its one-entries. We study entry-query testing of binary rank at most $d$, with one-sided error and nonadaptive queries. We give a tester using $\tilde O(d^4/\epsilon^2)$ queries, independent of the matrix dimensions and a general lower bound of $\tilde \Omega(d^{3/2}/\epsilon)$.

translated_title: 二进制秩的非自适应单边测试
translated_abstract: 二进制矩阵的二进制秩是指能够划分其所有1元素的不相交全1矩形的最小数量。我们研究了二进制秩至多为 $d$ 的元素查询测试问题，采用单边错误和非自适应查询。我们给出了一个使用 $\tilde O(d^4/\epsilon^2)$ 次查询的测试器，其查询复杂度与矩阵维度无关，并证明了一般下界为 $\tilde\Omega(d^{3/2}/\epsilon)$。
tldr: 本文研究了二进制秩的单边错误非自适应测试问题，给出了与矩阵维度无关的 $\tilde O(d^4/\epsilon^2)$ 查询复杂度上界和 $\tilde\Omega(d^{3/2}/\epsilon)$ 的一般下界。
